newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Auto set to list 270 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: First Auto set to list 270 mln A shares.

text.p: China's First Automobile Works Car Co Ltd will list 270 million A shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange next week under its 2.0 billion yuan ($241 million) initial public offer, an official involved in the issue said on Tuesday.
The shares, priced at 6.80 yuan each, will start trading on Wednesday next week.
China's Xinhua news agency has said the initial public offer was the largest capital raising exercise involving the Shenzhen stock exchange.
The offer was 50 times oversubscribed, an official at chief underwriter Haitong Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
First Auto, based in Changchun, capital of northeastern Jilin province, has a joint venture with Volkswagen AG in Changchun to produce Jetta cars.
